content: Is everything ready for Billy's birthday party?
Yes. I've finished making the birthday cake and I've put all the things on the table. Did you find the party hats?
Yes, I did. I've put one on the table for each child. I put up the big 'happy birthday' sign too.
Thanks. Do you think we have enough for the kids to eat and drink?
I'm sure of that. There's enough food here to feed an army!
That birthday cake looks wonderful, but you haven't put any candles on it yet.
Thanks for reminding me. I've prepared some party games for the children too.
I've brought a tape with lots of children's songs on it.
Hopefully, that will keep everyone happy.
